snippet.title: Astrobuilder trailer
snippet.description:
🚀 Astrobuilder – Become anyone in a living, breathing galaxy.
Explore a dynamic AI-driven universe where every NPC has a story, every decision changes the world, and you can rise from a humble merchant to a legendary figure.
🛰️ Shape your journey in this space RPG meets AI simulation, featuring trade routes, shifting alliances, and a galaxy on the brink of chaos.
✨ Wishlist on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/3105960/Astrobuilder/
📌 Follow for updates:
X (Twitter): https://x.com/AstrobuilderAI
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/EKFjcrEj5Q
